stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#10
stages.text: Giyera, Malick's telekinetic Inhuman, floats a gun to shoot Daisy as she hacks into Hydra's systems at its castle. Joey melts the bullets and Lincoln knocks Giyera down.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Malick's telekinetic Inhuman. Tries to shoot Daisy at the Hydra castle.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An Inhuman Giyera tries to shoot as she hacks Hydra's castle.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
stages.text: Now loyal to Hive, Giyera fights the Secret Warriors as they storm Hydra's base to retake Zephyr One, and Daisy knocks him out with a shockwave.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Hive's telekinetic follower. Daisy knocks him out with a shockwave.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Blasts Giyera with a shockwave and knocks him out.
